title: thumbnail
description: Screen preview. On the command channel it answers `remote_input` `get_thumbnail`: the server replaces `hw_id` with the connection's device ID, resolves a waiting `GET /api/thumbnail/{pc}` and forwards it to admin panels only. On the Vision channel it is forwarded unchanged, like `stream_frame`, to the holders of a remote-control session for the device.

hw_id.description: The agent's own device ID. Overwritten by the server on the command channel.
